user.title: Choose an Art Frame
user.description: Pick an Art Frame that is already set up in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration.

abort.no_art_frames: No Art Frames found. Set the frame up in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration first.
abort.already_configured: Every Art Frame is already set up here.

delete_image.name: Delete image
delete_image.description: Deletes one image stored on the Art Frame. If it is the image on display, the frame switches to the next image first.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image ID from the sensor's Image IDs attribute, or first, last or current (first and last follow the order the frame lists them in).
